name: Launcher Card
description: An interactive application destination card with an icon, description, optional status, and an honest unavailable state.
usage:
<LauncherCard
  href="https://photos.example"
  label="Photos"
  description="Household media, albums, and sharing"
  icon={<Camera />}
  status={<Badge variant="success">Healthy</Badge>}
/>

anatomy.description: The application glyph at the start of the card.
The destination name and its one-line summary.
Caller-supplied status content, such as a Badge, rendered below the summary.
The disabled treatment that blocks navigation and leaves the focus order.

dos: Use it for application or destination grids where the whole card navigates.
Keep descriptions to one scannable line.
Show an honest unavailable state instead of hiding the destination.
donts: Don't use it for minor links inside prose; use a plain Link.
Don't nest interactive controls inside; the whole card is the link.

examples.title: Available application
examples.description: The whole card navigates; status content stays caller-supplied and sanitized.

examples.title: Unavailable application
examples.description: A disabled card is removed from focus order and blocks navigation.

guidance.useWhen: An application destination needs a prominent, scannable entry point.
guidance.avoidWhen: The destination is a minor link inside prose; use a plain link instead.
guidance.behavior: Disabled cards leave the focus order and block navigation instead of hiding.
guidance.responsive: Cards stack single-column on mobile and grid at larger widths under the caller’s layout.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the card link.

notes: The whole card is a single anchor, so its label and description are announced together as the link name.
Disabled cards are removed from the focus order and block navigation instead of being hidden.
Status content is caller-supplied; keep it textual, like a Badge, so it is announced.

props.description: Short supporting line shown under the label.
props.name: description

props.description: Renders the card unavailable and blocks navigation.
props.name: disabled

props.description: Status content rendered below the description, such as a health Badge.
props.name: status
